purpose: Test the region-tagged workflow on an external image classifier (VNN-COMP mnist_fc, mnist-net_256x2) we did not train, with at least one genuinely data-conditioned non-box region (R4 local PCA; R3 class-AE if feasible) via composed ONNX + Marabou CLI.
network: external/vnncomp/mnist_fc/onnx/mnist-net_256x2.onnx (784-256-256-10 ReLU; input [1,784,1] in [0,1]); not trained by us
anchor_selection: 20 held-out test anchors, 2 per class, correctly classified by mnist_fc, ascending test index
target_class_rule: highest non-true logit at the clean anchor x0

R4.encoding: composed ONNX z -> x0 + V_d^T z -> mnist_fc -> logits; verify z-box |z_j| <= alpha*sigma_j

R3.source: mnist_class_aes.npz (class decoders z(8)->ReLU(32)->linear(784), trained on MNIST train split)
R3.encoding: composed ONNX z -> D_k(z) -> mnist_fc -> logits

property: targeted class confusion: logit_target >= logit_true (SAT = confusion witness exists)
solver: Marabou 2.0 CLI on composed/base ONNX, split-and-conquer, 4 workers, 120 s per query
status_parsing: exact token match: 'sat' or 'unsat' in tokenized output; never substring
note: Composition uses onnx 1.16.2 + onnxruntime 1.19.2 in prophecy_env (both import fine; only maraboupy hangs, so the CLI is used). Specs of VNN-COMP files are not modified; this region-transfer run is separate from the mnist_fc expected-label plumbing calibration.
